descriptionHtml:
Onikuma M930 Studio RGB Microphone with 48kHz High-Fidelity Capture and Smart Monitoring

Broadcast your voice with crystal-clear studio precision and upgrade your streaming setup with the Onikuma M930 Studio RGB Microphone. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance PC hardware audio recording peripheral is masterfully engineered for tactical esports players, professional live stream operators, and active digital website managers across Egypt who demand studio-grade acoustic accuracy, smooth voice capture, and zero-latency monitoring. Equipped with a stable shock-absorption stand, this desktop microphone is optimized to deliver pro-tier communication framework paths.

The Onikuma M930 is driven by an advanced internal audio processing core that delivers crisp 48kHz high-definition sound sampling rates, ensuring your voice is natural and clear for streams, podcasts, or team chats. It features a built-in smart monitoring audio port for real-time headphone tracking with absolutely zero lag. Designed for effortless control during heated sessions, the top features a seamless one-touch capacitive mute button line. Finished with vibrant, flowing dynamic RGB breathing gradient lights, this USB plug-and-play microphone delivers immediate multi-device support across PC setups and console frameworks.
